summary: Do not send stall notices for cancelled, completed or failed mission runs

replay.detail: No projection replay or history rewrite. Stall evaluation now checks the existing run status as well as its phase. Previously sent messages remain in history.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, claim fields or generated client inputs change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and claim registry are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Named and default reporters no longer receive stall notices or schedule stall deadlines for terminal run statuses, even when an active phase or ready steps remain in the supplied view. Existing transactional cancellation continues to settle non-final steps immediately and preserves finally work until cleanup finishes. No client, protocol or harness fields change.

downtime.detail: No migration or coordinated interruption is required.

manual.detail: The corrected stall eligibility applies automatically after upgrading from earlier versions.

recovery.detail: Returning to the previous binary restores phase-only stall eligibility. Run state and existing report history are unchanged.
